# Manan's Agent Skills

> Free, open-source agent plugins and skills by Manan Suneja.

## PM OS

- [Install PM OS](https://manansuneja.github.io/skills/install.md): how an AI agent installs the PM OS plugin, for shell-capable agents and for chat apps.
- [PM OS guide](https://manansuneja.github.io/skills/): step-by-step setup for people.
- [Source](https://github.com/manansuneja/skills/tree/main/skills/product-management/pm-os)
